title: Note
description: The Markdown document per save — the source of truth for everything textual. Frontmatter holds stable facts only: `source, channel, video_url, duration, published, saved, folder, tags`. Confidence/processing state never appears here.

markdown.description: Full document: YAML frontmatter + body. Overview + Key points + Links are LLM-guaranteed sections; others are dynamic and user-deletable.

frontmatter.description: Stable facts only. Suggested_folder/confidence/processing state deliberately excluded (API metadata on save/job).

folder.description: Folder path as text. Kept in sync by bulk rewrite on folder rename/move — not an independent field.

transcript.description: Text only. Timestamped lines. Audio/video is never stored (ADR 0004).
